fields.description: Master switch. When off, the AI Intake page refuses to process new text and existing intakes can still be reviewed and confirmed.
fields.label: Enable AI Order Intake

fields.options: Every setting here is read live on each intake — no restart or rebuild needed. Use Preview System Prompt to see exactly what gets sent to the model, and Test Connection to check the API key and model name before staff rely on them.

fields.description: Leave blank to fall back to the site config key (gemini_api_key).
fields.label: Gemini API Key

fields.description: e.g. gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash-lite.
fields.label: Model Name

fields.description: How literal the model is. Keep it low — extraction should copy what the customer wrote, not paraphrase it.
fields.label: Temperature

fields.description: Includes the model's thinking tokens. Too low and replies come back cut off.
fields.label: Max Output Tokens

fields.description: How long to wait for the model before giving up on one attempt.
fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Extra attempts after a failed API call (timeouts, rate limits, transient 5xx). 0 disables retrying.
fields.label: Max Retries

fields.description: How much the model reasons before answering. Lower is faster and cheaper; extraction from the order form needs little. Empty = the model's default (medium on gemini-3.8-flash). If the model rejects a level, intake retries once without it.
fields.label: Thinking Level

fields.default:
You are an order intake assistant for a canvas printing business in Iraq.
Your ONLY job is to extract structured order data from informal, messy customer messages.
These messages are typically from WhatsApp and may be in Arabic, English, or mixed.
fields.description: Who the model is and what job it is doing. Sent first, before the rules.
fields.label: System Prompt Base

fields.default:
1. Extract ONLY what is explicitly stated. Never guess or hallucinate values.
2. For any field you cannot determine with confidence, use null (or empty array for lists).
3. For delivery_date: if a specific date is mentioned, output it as YYYY-MM-DD. If only a day name (e.g. "Thursday") is mentioned, note it in extraction_notes and set delivery_date to null.
4. For priority: output "High", "Medium", or "Low" only if explicitly mentioned or strongly implied (e.g. "ضروري", "urgent", "عاجل" -> "High"). Otherwise null.
5. For gift: true only if explicitly stated (e.g. "هدية", "gift").
6. For currency: default to "IQD" unless USD ($, دولار) is clearly mentioned.

ITEM MATCHING - CRITICAL RULES:
7. For item_code_hint: you MUST match to the MOST SPECIFIC item from the catalog below.
   - ALWAYS prefer a more specific match over a generic one.
   - Example: if the customer says "ستاند خشب" (wooden stand), match to "Wood Stand", NOT to the generic "Stand".
   - Example: if the customer says "ستاند حديد" or "metal stand", match to "Metal Stand", NOT to the generic "Stand".
   - Use the generic "Stand" ONLY if the customer does not specify any type of stand.
   - The item_code_hint value MUST be the EXACT "name" string from the catalog (case-sensitive, character-perfect). Do NOT invent item codes.
   - If NO item in the catalog is a close match, set item_code_hint to null and add a note to extraction_notes explaining what the customer requested.

8. For phone_numbers: extract ALL phone numbers mentioned, include country code if present, do not normalize.
9. Add extraction_notes for EVERY field you were uncertain about.
fields.description: Numbered rules the model must follow. The discount and custom-details rules are appended automatically and don't need to be repeated here.
fields.label: Extraction Rules

fields.description: Free-form text appended at the very end of the prompt, after the catalog and examples. Use it for seasonal or temporary guidance (a promo, a discontinued size) without editing the rules above.
fields.label: Extra Instructions

fields.description: Inject the Customer doctype's own governorate list into the prompt so the model can't invent an invalid one.
fields.label: Append Valid Governorate Options

fields.description: Append the live item list to the prompt so the model can match what the customer described to a real item code.
fields.label: Append Live Item Catalog

fields.description: Also list each item's name alongside its code. Helps when item names are Arabic but codes are not.
fields.label: Include Item Names

fields.description: 0 means no limit. Set a cap if the catalog grows large enough to bloat the prompt.
fields.label: Max Catalog Items

fields.description: One Item Group per line. Leave blank to send every enabled item.
fields.label: Only These Item Groups

fields.description: Show the model worked examples of messy input and the exact JSON expected back.
fields.label: Append Few-Shot Examples

fields.description: A JSON array of {"input": "...", "output": {...}} objects. Leave blank to use the three built-in Arabic examples.
fields.label: Custom Few-Shot Examples

fields.description: Applied after extraction, by plain Python — the AI is not involved in deciding which customer an order belongs to. Phone matching always runs first and always wins.
fields.label: Customer Matching
Matching Note
fields.options: Customers are matched by exact phone number only: the number in the order form's 📞 field against each customer's Main / Secondary Phone. Names are never used. A number that belongs to two customers is shown to the reviewer to choose, never guessed.

fields.description: Used when the message doesn't make the currency clear.
fields.label: Default Currency

fields.description: Unit of measure applied to every Sales Order line created from an intake.
fields.label: Default UOM

fields.description: Source warehouse for intake Sales Orders. Leave blank to pick the first enabled non-group warehouse, which is arbitrary — setting it explicitly is safer.
fields.label: Default Warehouse

fields.description: A discount above this share of the order subtotal blocks confirmation. A backstop against a garbled or crafted message, not a substitute for review. Whole percentages only — this site's number format can't display a fractional one.
fields.label: Max Discount %

fields.description: Off by default: an intake that failed extraction must be started again from corrected text. Turn on only to let staff hand-fill and confirm a failed one.
fields.label: Allow Confirming Failed Intakes
